title: Universal Refusal Circuits Across LLMs: Cross-Model Transfer via Trajectory Replay and Concept-Basis Reconstruction
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanistic properties of refusal circuits in LLMs and how they can be transferred between models. While it deals with safety alignment (e.g., refusing harmful prompts), it focuses on the internal representation and transferability of these behaviors rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems or reasoning.
